mapper.insert: INSERT INTO csul_req_mgmt (fd_tec_id, co_nm, co_biz_no, co_addr_id, sndr_nm, sndr_phn_no, sndr_eml, sol_tp_ids, sol_tgt_ids, sol_title, sol_dtl, cre_usr_id, upd_usr_id) VALUES ( #{foodTechId}, #{companyName}, #{companyBizNo}, #{companyAddressId}, #{senderName}, #{senderPhoneNo}, #{senderEmail}, #{solutionTypeIds, jdbcType=ARRAY, javaType=java.util.List, typeHandler=egovframework.com.config.mybatis.JdbcArrayAndJavaListTypeHandler}, #{solutionTargetIds, jdbcType=ARRAY, javaType=java.util.List, typeHandler=egovframework.com.config.mybatis.JdbcArrayAndJavaListTypeHandler}, #{solutionTitle}, #{solutionDetail}, 0, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT req.id, ( SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'code', intg_cd_val_ctnt, 'content', intg_cd_dp_val_desc, 'description', intg_cd_val_desc, 'seq', intg_cd_val_seq ) FROM com_intg_cd_dtl WHERE intg_cd = 'CD00016' AND intg_cd_val_ctnt = req.fd_tec_id ) AS food_tech, req.co_nm AS company_name, req.co_biz_no AS company_biz_no, ( SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'code', intg_cd_val_ctnt, 'content', intg_cd_dp_val_desc, 'description', intg_cd_val_desc, 'seq', intg_cd_val_seq ) FROM com_intg_cd_dtl WHERE intg_cd = 'CD00017' AND intg_cd_val_ctnt = req.co_addr_id ) AS company_address, req.sndr_nm AS sender_name, req.sndr_phn_no AS sender_phone_no, req.sndr_eml AS sender_email, ( SELECT jsonb_agg( jsonb_build_object( 'code', intg_cd_val_ctnt, 'content', intg_cd_dp_val_desc, 'description', intg_cd_val_desc, 'seq', intg_cd_val_seq ) ) FROM com_intg_cd_dtl WHERE intg_cd = 'CD00018' AND intg_cd_val_ctnt = ANY(req.sol_tp_ids) ) AS solution_types, ( SELECT jsonb_agg( jsonb_build_object( 'code', intg_cd_val_ctnt, 'content', intg_cd_dp_val_desc, 'description', intg_cd_val_desc, 'seq', intg_cd_val_seq ) ) FROM com_intg_cd_dtl WHERE intg_cd = 'CD00019' AND intg_cd_val_ctnt = ANY(req.sol_tgt_ids) ) AS solution_targets, req.sol_title AS solution_title, req.sol_dtl AS solution_detail, req.cre_dt FROM csul_req_mgmt req OFFSET ${(page - 1) * limit} LIMIT ${limit}

SELECT req.id, ( SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'code', intg_cd_val_ctnt, 'content', intg_cd_dp_val_desc, 'description', intg_cd_val_desc, 'seq', intg_cd_val_seq ) FROM com_intg_cd_dtl WHERE intg_cd = 'CD00016' AND intg_cd_val_ctnt = req.fd_tec_id ) AS food_tech, req.co_nm AS company_name, req.co_biz_no AS company_biz_no, ( SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'code', intg_cd_val_ctnt, 'content', intg_cd_dp_val_desc, 'description', intg_cd_val_desc, 'seq', intg_cd_val_seq ) FROM com_intg_cd_dtl WHERE intg_cd = 'CD00017' AND intg_cd_val_ctnt = req.co_addr_id ) AS company_address, req.sndr_nm AS sender_name, req.sndr_phn_no AS sender_phone_no, req.sndr_eml AS sender_email, ( SELECT jsonb_agg( jsonb_build_object( 'code', intg_cd_val_ctnt, 'content', intg_cd_dp_val_desc, 'description', intg_cd_val_desc, 'seq', intg_cd_val_seq ) ) FROM com_intg_cd_dtl WHERE intg_cd = 'CD00018' AND intg_cd_val_ctnt = ANY(req.sol_tp_ids) ) AS solution_types, ( SELECT jsonb_agg( jsonb_build_object( 'code', intg_cd_val_ctnt, 'content', intg_cd_dp_val_desc, 'description', intg_cd_val_desc, 'seq', intg_cd_val_seq ) ) FROM com_intg_cd_dtl WHERE intg_cd = 'CD00019' AND intg_cd_val_ctnt = ANY(req.sol_tgt_ids) ) AS solution_targets, req.sol_title AS solution_title, req.sol_dtl AS solution_detail, req.cre_dt FROM csul_req_mgmt req WHERE req.id = #{id}
